Densities, masses, tails, and quantiles of 12 families in 13 parameterizations, each in a scalar form and an _array batch form, with a seeded sampler. Inputs, results, and error codes follow the shared rules; families and domains are in Probability distributions.

Normal

Parameter Type Default Description
$mean float 0.0 Mean
$sd float 1.0 Standard deviation, > 0
Function Operation Arguments Returns
dist_normal_pdf() Density float $x, parameters float
dist_normal_pdf_array() Density over a list array $values, parameters array
dist_normal_logpdf() Log density float $x, parameters float
dist_normal_logpdf_array() Log density over a list array $values, parameters array
dist_normal_cdf() Lower tail P(X ≤ x) float $x, parameters float
dist_normal_cdf_array() Lower tail P(X ≤ x) over a list array $values, parameters array
dist_normal_logcdf() Log lower tail float $x, parameters float
dist_normal_logcdf_array() Log lower tail over a list array $values, parameters array
dist_normal_sf() Upper tail P(X > x) float $x, parameters float
dist_normal_sf_array() Upper tail P(X > x) over a list array $values, parameters array
dist_normal_logsf() Log upper tail float $x, parameters float
dist_normal_logsf_array() Log upper tail over a list array $values, parameters array
dist_normal_quantile() Quantile float $p, parameters float
dist_normal_quantile_array() Quantile over a list array $probabilities, parameters array
dist_normal_rng() Seeded samples int $n, int $seed, parameters array 
Phit\dist_normal_cdf(    float $x,    float $mean = 0.0,    float $sd = 1.0,): floatPhit\dist_normal_cdf_array(    array $values,    float $mean = 0.0,    float $sd = 1.0,): array

Errors Exception: code 1001 for an invalid parameter, 1003 for a NAN input, or 1006 for a numerical failure.

Sampler errors Exception: code 1001 for invalid input, 1003 for a nonfinite parameter or sample, or 1007 for more than 1,000,000 draws or an unsupported size.
